description: Get the dollar value of funding actually paid at each settlement -- not just the rate -- and which side, longs or shorts, paid it. Every response carries both the per-coin row breakdown and a totals block (net/long_paid/short_paid) for the requested window and class, so 'who paid funding today' is read directly from totals rather than summed from a page of rows; totals always reflects the full requested class regardless of any coin/exchange filter on the rows. window=current (the default) is the next 24 hours of funding at current rates -- each contract's forward rate x 24 / its own interval hours, priced live off open interest -- always estimated, never realised. 1d/3d/7d are realised windows; one whose coverage is below 90% carries partial: true (complete: false) because its history is still accruing, not a completed total, and halted_within_window says a contract stopped settling inside the window (listed_within_window is always null: no listing time is known). Sign convention: a window's net = long_paid - short_paid; positive means longs paid more than they received (a cost to longs), negative means shorts paid more. Both long_paid and short_paid are always non-negative magnitudes. Missing is null, never 0. class scopes to one category as on the funding board (crypto, equity, commodity, fx, index), or rwa = every non-crypto class; the five classes' totals, and crypto + rwa, always equal the all totals.

class.description: Asset-class scope, the same categories as the funding board: `all`, `crypto`, `equity`, `commodity`, `fx` or `index` (one `asset_class` each). `rwa` is every non-crypto class at once (equity + commodity + fx + index). In the `totals` block the five classes, and `crypto` + `rwa`, reconcile exactly to `all`.

coin.description: Comma-separated coins, for example BTC,ETH. Each names an asset as on /funding/rates: full names resolve (bitcoin -> BTC) and any spelling finds the asset's one row (PEPE, 1000PEPE and KPEPE all answer the PEPE row). Unfiltered by default.

exchange.description: Filter to coins settling on a single venue. Accepts the slug, the display name as returned in the `venues[].exchange` field, or the ccxt id. The venue registry is not frozen, so read the `sharpe://exchanges` MCP resource or /api/funding/rates for the current list. An unrecognized value returns 400. Implies the per-venue breakdown internally; the response still omits `venues` unless `expand=venues` is also set.

expand.description: Set to `venues` to include each row's per-venue breakdown. Omitted by default to keep the default payload small.

sort.description: Sort field for the selected `window`, optionally prefixed with "-" for descending. Rows with no value for the sort field (an unpriced coin) always sort last, regardless of direction.

window.description: Settlement window. `current` is the next 24 hours of funding at current rates (each contract's forward rate x 24 / its own interval hours, priced live off open interest) and labelled `estimated`. `1d`/`3d`/`7d` are realised windows from the funding_fee_settlement matview.

name: get_funding_settlement

OpenInterestExclusion.description: A venue whose stored open interest is published per venue but left out of every cross-venue total, and why. MEXC and BingX today: MEXC's holdVol moves 7.00x the position change of its own deal feed, so it fits neither side count; BingX's figure moved faster than its own trades allow and is no longer read, so only its stored history remains.

coins.description: Coins in the selected class, matching the scope of `totals` -- independent of any coin/exchange filter or pagination on this specific request.

oi_excluded_venues.description: Venues whose settlement dollars are left out of every coin row and the totals (shown only in the venues breakdown), with the reason.

total.description: Coins matching this request's coin/exchange filters, before pagination.

updated_at.description: When the settlement data was refreshed (the funding_fee_settlement matview's refresh, every 15 minutes), not the request time.

asset_id.description: The instrument master's CoinGecko id the row groups by (`pepe`), or `null` when it groups by ticker (non-crypto assets, and coins the master has not placed). Two coins can share a ticker (MEME is both `memecoin-2` and `a-meme-coin`): `asset_id` tells their rows apart.

base_coin.description: The row's ticker: the coin's asset_symbol when the instrument master knows it, else the underlying ticker. Rows follow the funding grid: one per instrument and asset class, so PEPE is one row over the PEPE, 1000PEPE and KPEPE contracts, KOSTOCK and NCSKKO2USD join KO, and a ticker two asset classes share is one row per class.

venues.description: Present only when expand=venues is requested.

excluded_from_totals.description: Present only on a venue whose open interest is priced per venue but left out of the coin row and the totals (MEXC today), with the reason.

SettlementWindowValue1d.description: net = long_paid - short_paid. Both legs are always present alongside net -- a $0 net can conceal $50M flowing each way. Null means an unpriced/absent contract, never a zero flow.

complete.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: true when coverage_ratio is at least 0.9 (the opposite of `partial`).

estimated.description: True on the current window only: priced live from the in-progress rate and latest open interest, not from the matview.

halted_within_window.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: true when a contract priced in the window stopped settling inside it: its funding row left the live book or went stale, and its last priced settlement plus one interval falls in the window. Its coverage is measured only up to that point, so a halt does not read as missing history.

listed_within_window.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: whether a contract behind the value was listed inside the window. Always `null` on this endpoint today: the settlement data prices seven days and carries no listing time, so a listing is unknown, never assumed.

partial.description: Realised windows only: true when coverage_ratio is below 0.9. The numbers still render -- partial means building history, not hidden.

rate_source.description: Where the current window's rate came from: `predicted` (the venue's `predicted_rate`, published only by Kraken, Crypto.com, Pacifica and Hyperliquid, where it equals `rate`), `current` (the row's `rate`), or `mixed` on a coin, venue or total row whose contracts used both. `current` is the normal path, and it is the forward estimate only where the funding book's `rate_kind` is `estimate`: on Bitfinex it is the last settled rate and on Deribit the trailing 8-hour realised rate, projected forward. `null` when no contract was priced.

A coin, venue or total row is the open-interest-weighted mean of its contracts' ratios; a contract that stopped settling (halted or delisted) is expected only until its last priced settlement plus one interval.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.
